name: Spider-Man
description: After being bitten by a genetically altered spider, high school student Peter Parker gains spider-like superpowers to fight crime.

name: The Dark Knight
description: Batman faces his greatest psychological and physical test when the chaotic criminal known as the Joker emerges in Gotham City.

name: Inception
description: A skilled thief who steals corporate secrets through dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into a CEO's mind.

name: Interstellar
description: When Earth becomes uninhabitable, a team of astronauts travels through a wormhole in space to find a new home for humanity.

name: The Matrix
description: A computer hacker learns from mysterious rebels about the true nature of his reality and his role in the war against its controllers.

name: Gladiator
description: A former Roman general sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.

name: Avatar
description: A paraplegic Marine dispatched to the moon Pandora on a unique mission becomes torn between following his orders and protecting the world he feels is his home.

name: Titanic
description: A seventeen-year-old aristocrat falls in love with a kind but poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated R.M.S. Titanic.

name: Joker
description: A mentally troubled comedian is disregarded and mistreated by society, embarking on a downward spiral that leads to the birth of an iconic villain.

name: Avengers: Endgame
description: After the devastating events of Infinity War, the surviving Avengers assemble once more to reverse Thanos's actions and restore balance to the universe.
